relevance_note: The paper reports four family members carrying a TNFAIP3 variant: "A heterozygous c.1727dupC variant in the TNFAIP3 gene (NM_006290), introducing the frameshift variant p.His577Alafs*95, was identified in the Pt1 and her mother (Pt 4)" and "The same frameshift mutation was also present in the two sisters, Pt2 and Pt3".
method_note: Read the full text and transcribed every value by hand; a Python script was used only to assemble the JSON (including the 20-row checklist per person) and to check that every span occurs verbatim in the paper. Table 1 is misaligned in the Markdown (only the first row of each patient block carries the patient ID and later rows are shifted left), so table rows were assigned to patients by block order and cross-checked against the Patients section; the father is included as a tested relative (trio WES, functional controls) with no clinical data and no variant row.

Three years later, she presented five relapses of hemolytic anaemia treated again with IV immunoglobulin and glucocorticoids. Because of the frequent relapses in January 2015 she was treated with rituximab. One year after the CD20 depletion treatment, asymptomatic hypogammaglobulinemia was found. Immunoglobulin replacement therapy was started, still ongoing.
